hero.title: Protect your family from funeral and burial costs

benefits.title: No cost to you
benefits.desc: Our guidance is free — we're paid by the insurance carrier, not by you.

benefits.title: Coverage even without an SSN
benefits.desc: No Social Security number? You can still get great coverage with no waiting period.

benefits.title: Simple, guided questions
benefits.desc: Just your basic information, address, and any medications — nothing complicated.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions, one at a time. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your information and contact you to finalize your coverage.

finalExpenseApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
finalExpenseApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
